summary: A generative firmware aimed at calm, sound-healing style music, combining generative instruments, Solfeggio tones, soft drums and binaural beats. Testing on the physical FM-1 is left to its author.
features: Solfeggio frequency tones and stereo binaural beats
Gentle drums; eight tracks and 16 voices across three music modes
Seven-page interface with mixer and saved banks
Performance MIDI over USB and Bluetooth is disabled
